assistant.noKeyTitle: AI Assistant requires a free Gemini API key
assistant.noKeyBody: The rest of GokulScheme AI (profile matching, all schemes, and filters) works without any API key. To enable the grounded AI chat locally:
assistant.noKeyStep1: Copy .env.example to .env in the project root.
assistant.noKeyStep2: Set GEMINI_API_KEY to your free Google AI Studio key.
assistant.noKeyStep3: Restart the server with npm run dev.

about.title: About GokulScheme AI
about.subtitle: Public-interest information tool for discovering Central and State government schemes in India.
about.whatItIsBody: GokulScheme AI helps citizens explore government welfare schemes, review plain-language eligibility summaries, and jump directly to official .gov.in and .nic.in application portals.
about.privacyBody: No login is required. Profile answers and chat conversations are stored only in temporary browser memory for your current session — never written to a database, never saved in cookies, and never logged on our servers. Only your chosen display language is saved locally in your browser.
about.disclaimerBody: GokulScheme AI is an independent informational service and is not affiliated with any Government of India or State Government body. Match labels (Likely, Possible, Check eligibility) are informational estimates only. The concerned government department or implementing agency makes the final eligibility decision.
